readability.rationale: Reviewer: small readable modules, no dead code after removing unused Result values.

maintainability.rationale: Reviewer found no gaps between docs, code and tests for J-01..J-04 and D-01..D-06; layering matches architecture; README documents run and verify.

security.rationale: Reviewer live-probed Host allowlist, cross-site POST guard incl. cancel route, Origin null, 413 body cap, malformed encoding, long ids, HTML injection (escaped). npm audit clean. Host allowlist now has an E2E assertion and is documented.

reliability.rationale: Reviewer: 5 simultaneous cancels gave 1x303/4x409; overlap guard re-confirmed. Ends-today cancel boundary now tested, and a mutation (>= to >) made that test fail.

scalability.rationale: Indexed lookups and a single local SQLite file match the local single-machine scope.

compatibility.rationale: No client JavaScript; Node >= 24 declared; Playwright browser install documented.

findings.resolution: Cancel journey test now reserves and cancels a today-only reservation; mutation check confirmed it fails on > instead of >=.

findings.summary: Too-long reserved-by and Host allowlist untested.
findings.resolution: Added assertions to the existing server-refusal tests.

findings.summary: Unused Result values in reserveEquipment, addEquipment, cancelReservation.
findings.resolution: Result simplified to { ok: true } | failure.

findings.summary: Test helper RegExp built from unescaped name.
findings.resolution: Name escaped before building the RegExp.

findings.summary: Host allowlist not in architecture doc.
findings.resolution: Added to Security line in docs/architecture.md.

tradeoffs: Not changed (accepted): refused POSTs render at the POST URL to keep form values, and a refresh re-submits harmlessly. The cancellable rule exists in the view and in SQL, and the SQL is authoritative. Global empty states are not E2E-tested because the E2E database is shared. Temp E2E DB files stay in the OS temp directory.
